obligations.name: archive_infra_channel
obligations.description: Among conversations reachable through the actor's own workspace membership, select the single channel whose topic_text names Kubernetes/AWS/on-call incident response, then archive it (set channels.is_archived to true).
obligations.scope: the one non-archived channel reachable via the actor's workspace membership with topic_text matching the K8s/AWS/on-call/incidents wording, excluding a topically similar channel in an inaccessible separate workspace

task_spec.text: Among channels the bot can access through its own workspace membership, identify the one whose topic covers Kubernetes, AWS, and on-call incident response.

access_plan: Call users.conversations (no team_id, ordinary token) to enumerate the channels the acting bot is actually a member of, which is naturally limited to team T01WORKSPACE; pull topic_text for each via conversations.info and match on the K8s/AWS/on-call/incidents wording to isolate the single non-archived match (C_INFRA). The lookalike channel C_INFRA_EU in T02NORTHSTAR never appears in this listing because the actor holds no membership or team access there, so the workspace relationship — not just topic wording — is what excludes it. Then call conversations.archive on the resolved channel ID.
